name: SIGMA - Registry Run Key Set to a Suspicious Path or Script Host
description:
Detects a value being written under the Run / RunOnce autostart keys (HKLM or HKCU,
native and WOW6432Node) whose data points to a temp / public / ProgramData location or
invokes a script host. Every program referenced there is started at user logon, which
gives persistence (and privilege escalation when an HKLM key is used). Restricting the
value data to suspicious locations removes the large volume of legitimate software that
registers itself under Program Files.

query_string.query: data.win.system.eventID:13 AND ((data.win.eventdata.targetObject:(*\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run\\* OR *\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\RunOnce\\* OR *\\Software\\WOW6432Node\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run\\*)) AND (data.win.eventdata.details:(*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\* OR *\\Windows\\Temp\\* OR *\\Users\\Public\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\* OR *powershell* OR *mshta* OR *rundll32* OR *wscript* OR *cscript* OR *%TEMP%*)))
